purpose: Bounded real-adapter qualification of LINZ NZ Primary Parcels for Wellington; raw source geometries and caches remain in /tmp, while repository sample is capped at three features.
crs: EPSG:4326 response; EPSG:2193 independent metric audit
sourceScope: LINZ states this layer contains current primary parcel polygons; its current layer and the non-primary layer together exclude historic and pending parcels. The REST schema exposes no timeInfo or lifecycle date field.
privacy: Requests only OBJECTID transport key, LINZ native id, appellation legal description and topology_type. No titles or owner-linked table fields are requested.

metricShapelyAudit.metricCrs: EPSG:2193 NZGD2000 / New Zealand Transverse Mercator 2000
metricShapelyAudit.projector: Node proj4 backend dependency; Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS 3.13.1
metricShapelyAudit.sampleScope: All unique source geometries returned in the bounded city window cells in this acceptance run.
